text.en:
of Presidential Decree No. 853 providing for the classification and valuation of timber and forest
lands for purposes of real property taxation is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 6. Fixing the Rate of Levy on Timber and Forest Lands. The real property tax on timber and forest lands
shall be uniform for all provinces, municipalities and cities and the annual rates thereof are hereby fixed as
"(a) For the province, one-half of one per cent of the assessed value of the taxable area of the property;
"(b) For the municipality, one-half of one per cent of the assessed value of the taxable area of the property;
or a combined rate of one per cent for the province and the municipality; and
"(c) For the city, one per cent for the assessed value of the taxable area of the property.
Done in the City of Manila, this 4th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
